Subscriptions.description: Operational killswitch and subscription tier quotas for Free and Pro users.

subscription_gating_enabled.description: Master operational killswitch to enforce or bypass feature gating and tier quotas.

max_owned_groups_free.description: Maximum number of groups a Free tier user can own concurrently.

max_owned_groups_pro.description: Maximum number of groups a Pro tier user can own concurrently.

max_members_per_group_free.description: Maximum member cap for groups owned by a Free user.

max_members_per_group_pro.description: Maximum member cap for groups owned by a Pro user.

ai_receipt_monthly_limit_free.description: Monthly quota of AI receipt scans allocated to Free users.

ai_receipt_monthly_limit_pro.description: Monthly quota of AI receipt scans allocated to Pro users.

Groups.description: General group limits, currency fallback defaults, and balance calculation debounce timers.

default_currency_code.description: Default ISO 4217 currency code applied when creating new groups without an explicit currency.

balance_computation_debounce_ms.description: Debounce duration in milliseconds before recalculating member balances following mutation events.

max_members_per_group.description: Fallback maximum member cap per group when tier gating is inactive.

Receipts.description: Thresholds and keyword blacklists for OCR receipt parsing and validation.

extracted_date_max_future_days.description: Maximum allowed days in the future for an OCR-extracted receipt date before being discarded.

ocr_safety_false_positives_blacklist.description: Comma-separated list of blacklisted terms for OCR false-positive filtering.

Settlements.description: Rate limiting and pacing thresholds for settlement reminders and nudges.

settlement_nudge_rate_limit_hours.description: Minimum hours that must elapse between sending settlement reminders to the same debtor.

General.description: Public support contact channels and developer profile attribution metadata.

support_email_address.description: Support email address displayed in-app for user inquiries.
